Variants.Content: Entry The Hand of the King is the closest political position to royal authority under the Iron Throne, responsible for signing orders, presiding over meetings, arranging administration, and acting on behalf of the Crown when the King is unable or unwilling to do so himself. It is neither an independent throne nor a mere steward: the power of the king's hand A loyal hand may be fettered by the king's suspicion, a capable hand may become a shadow on the throne; the position itself is always between responsibility and scapegoat.
